entities.name: PMID:27497158
observations: 2016 human study isolated peripheral blood B cells from atherosclerosis patients; patient B cells had lower IL-10 than healthy controls, with IL-10 inversely correlated with miR-19a.
TNF-α, IFN-γ, or IL-4 increased B-cell miR-19a and suppressed IL-10; miR-19a inhibition abolished this cytokine-associated suppression. This supports mediation, not necessarily direct targeting.

entities.name: miR-19a
observations: In peripheral B cells studied in atherosclerosis, miR-19a was inversely correlated with IL-10; inhibiting miR-19a abolished cytokine-induced IL-10 suppression.
